source.name: Cyclingnews - Lidl-Trek reveal signature colourful jersey for 2026, complete with new AI sponsor (Matilda Price)
source.quote: featuring largely a navy blue base with geometric dashes of yellow and red, emulating the colours of sponsor – and now majority stakeholder – Lidl
source.note: Kit launch coverage; the jersey is worn by the men's and women's WorldTour teams.

source.name: Cyclingflash - More blue and new sponsors on Lidl-Trek's 2026 kit
source.quote: On the new 2026 kit, blue is the main color on the chest, also in multiple shades. The Trek sponsor name is in dark blue.

source.name: Cyclingflash - More blue and new sponsors on Lidl-Trek's 2026 kit
source.quote: ServiceNow, a new AI partner of Lidl-Trek, has a prominent spot below Lidl and Trek on the front.

source.name: Cyclingflash - More blue and new sponsors on Lidl-Trek's 2026 kit
source.quote: The sports drink brand Gatorade has a place on the left shoulder.
source.note: Source says left shoulder; the launch photos (Cyclingnews, Velora) show the Gatorade mark on the upper chest of the jersey front, wearer's left.

source.name: Cyclingflash - More blue and new sponsors on Lidl-Trek's 2026 kit
source.quote: Other sponsors such as Trek (shoulder), Pirelli, Santini, SRAM (on the chest), Crivit (sleeve), and Unbroken (side) are prominently displayed on the jersey.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam; jersey shared with the men's WorldTeam. Lidl is the big chest logo (and team majority owner per Cyclingnews), with Trek and ServiceNow below it, Pirelli, Santini and SRAM on the chest, Gatorade and Crivit on the sleeves/shoulder and Unbroken on the side panel. The back (seen in the official Santini replica product photos) repeats Lidl, Trek, ServiceNow and Santini, plus Trek's house brand Bontrager (not listed - see PR).
